retainedReference.title: Nymphenburg Palace, four courts and red roofs

pictures.author: Carsten Steger
pictures.observed: Actually inspected1280px oblique aerial: white/pale central multi-storey pavilion with red hip roof, lower connecting galleries and stepped side pavilions, long red-tiled ranges around four open outer courts, dormers/chimneys and west garden terrace. The outer crescent of detached eastern houses, canals, fountains and gardens are independent context.

pictures.author: JohannesSch. (Serafim 89)
pictures.observed: Actually inspected loaded960px western pavilion detail: pale stone/rusticated corners and off-white pilasters, vertically stacked crossed casements, tall round-headed central windows, small mezzanine windows, heavy dentilled cornice, restrained ochre/gold ornamental fields and stone terrace balustrade. Copied portrait medallions/heraldic relief/lettering omitted; abstract original detail only.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Nymphenburg Palace principal connected exterior: central pale Baroque pavilion, stepped side pavilions, lower galleries and both pairs of outer courtyard ranges. Four mapped courts stay open. Two mapped bridge galleries have a clear lower passage between reconstructed supporting piers. Red ceramic hip roofs, dormers/stacks, crossed windows/tall central arched windows, pale pilasters/cornices, restrained original ochre detail, west terrace/balustrade and a true east entrance recess/soffit/threshold/steps. Detached crescent houses, garden pavilions, canals, fountains and gardens remain map context. No furnished rooms, copied portraits/arms/inscriptions or exact sculptural relief.
